svg.title: Automated accessibility enhancer: production architecture
svg.desc: A faculty member opens accessibilityenhancer.com/app. A Cloudflare Pages Function forwards the request to the Flask website on AWS ECS Express Mode, which saves the deck to an S3 uploads bucket. The upload starts a Lambda function that asks Claude on Amazon Bedrock for alt text, writes the fixed deck and report to an S3 processed bucket, and records the status in DynamoDB. The website reads the status from DynamoDB, and the browser downloads the result straight from S3 through a presigned link. GitHub Actions builds the images into ECR and runs terraform apply. Every page needs an Amazon Cognito account, except the health check the load balancer uses.
svg.text: on merge to main · OIDC, no stored keys
download via presigned link, straight from S3
